Whether a unit is complete

Source: R/glow_run_records.R
glow_unit_state.Rd

A unit is complete when its record exists and every output the record lists exists. With dependencies, the record also has to state the same dependencies.

glow_unit_state(folder, part, unit = NULL, dependencies = NULL)

Arguments

folder

The folder of the part (its records are in records/ there).

part

The name of the part.

unit

The name of the unit, such as chr21, or NULL for a part that is not split.

dependencies

The current dependencies of the unit (see glow_unit_begin()), or NULL to check the record and its outputs only.

Value

A list: complete (logical), reason (a sentence when not complete, else an empty string), record (the record, or NULL), differences (see glow_dependency_differences()), stale (logical) and missing (the outputs of the record that do not exist). A unit is stale when its record differs from the current dependencies in its inputs only: a part it read was produced again since, with the same settings. Its results belong to an input that is gone, so it runs again without a question.

Details

The dependencies are compared whether or not the outputs exist, so a record with other settings is reported as such also when one of its files was deleted. For a seed record (see glow_seed_unit()) the settings that the record names are compared: dependencies$setting_text, when it is a function, is called with those names and returns their current text.

Examples

glow_unit_state(tempdir(), "scan", "chr21")$reason
#> [1] "it has no completion record"
